entities.name: Alfred Duvaucel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfred Duvaucel was a French naturalist and explorer. He was the stepson of Georges Cuvier and travelled in India and Southeast Asia as a collector of specimens for the Museum of Natural History in Paris.
